import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS_NUM = 1000000007;
    static class ModNumber {
        int v;

        ModNumber(long val_in) {
            val_in %= MODULUS_NUM;
            if (val_in < 0) val_in += MODULUS_NUM;
            v = (int) val_in;
        }

        static int extendedGCD(int a, int m, int[] xy) {
            if (m == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1; xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            int[] yx = new int[2];
            int g = extendedGCD(m, a % m, yx);
            xy[0] = yx[1];
            xy[1] = yx[0] - (a / m) * yx[1];
            return g;
        }

        static int modInverse(int a) {
            int[] xy = new int[2];
            extendedGCD(a, MODULUS_NUM, xy);
            int x = xy[0];
            return (x % MODULUS_NUM + MODULUS_NUM) % MODULUS_NUM;
        }

        ModNumber add(ModNumber other) {
            int res = v + other.v;
            if (res >= MODULUS_NUM) res -= MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber subtract(ModNumber other) {
            int res = v - other.v;
            if (res < 0) res += MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber multiply(ModNumber other) {
            long res = (long) v * other.v;
            res %= MODULUS_NUM;
            return new ModNumber(res);
        }

        ModNumber divide(ModNumber other) {
            return multiply(new ModNumber(modInverse(other.v)));
        }

        ModNumber pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModNumber base = this, result = new ModNumber(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof ModNumber)) return false;
            ModNumber that = (ModNumber) o;
            return v == that.v;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(v);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_Ns_5 = sc.nextInt();
        ModNumber[][] prob_mat_5 = new ModNumber[total_Ns_5][total_Ns_5];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_Ns_5; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < total_Ns_5; j++) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                prob_mat_5[i][j] = new ModNumber(p).divide(new ModNumber(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_by_count_5 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int c = 0; c <= total_Ns_5; c++) {
            masks_by_count_5.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup_idx_5 = new int[1 << total_Ns_5];
        Arrays.fill(lookup_idx_5, -1);
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << total_Ns_5); m++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(m);
            lookup_idx_5[m] = masks_by_count_5.get(c).size();
            masks_by_count_5.get(c).add(m);
        }

        Map<Long, ModNumber> possible_states_5 = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << lookup_idx_5[0];
        possible_states_5.put(initial_mask, new ModNumber(1));

        for (int left_part = 0; left_part < total_Ns_5; left_part++) {
            Map<Long, ModNumber> new_states_5 = new HashMap<>();
            ModNumber[] product_mask_vec = new ModNumber[1 << total_Ns_5];
            Arrays.fill(product_mask_vec, new ModNumber(1));
            for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << total_Ns_5); current_mask++) {
                ModNumber prod = new ModNumber(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < total_Ns_5; r++) {
                    if (((current_mask >> r) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(prob_mat_5[left_part][r]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new ModNumber(1).subtract(prob_mat_5[left_part][r]));
                    }
                }
                product_mask_vec[current_mask] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits_vec = new long[total_Ns_5];
            ModNumber[] new_possible_mask_vec = new ModNumber[1 << total_Ns_5];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new ModNumber(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> state : possible_states_5.entrySet()) {
                long current_mask_state = state.getKey();
                ModNumber prob_value = state.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits_vec, 0);
                for (int m : masks_by_count_5.get(left_part)) {
                    if (((current_mask_state >> lookup_idx_5[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < total_Ns_5; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long new_mask = 1L << lookup_idx_5[m | (1 << i)];
                                new_bits_vec[i] |= new_mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new ModNumber(0));
                for (int curr_mask = 1; curr_mask < (1 << total_Ns_5); curr_mask++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(curr_mask);
                    long prev_mask = curr_mask & (curr_mask - 1);
                    new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask_vec[(int) prev_mask].add(new ModNumber(new_bits_vec[ctz]));
                    long new_mask_value = new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask].hashCode(); // Using hashCode as a stand-in for actual mask
                    long combined_mask = new_mask_value;
                    ModNumber val = prob_value.multiply(product_mask_vec[curr_mask]);
                    new_states_5.put(combined_mask, new_states_5.getOrDefault(combined_mask, new ModNumber(0)).add(val));
                }
            }
            possible_states_5 = new_states_5;
        }

        ModNumber total_res_5 = new ModNumber(0);
        long final_mask_bit = 1L << lookup_idx_5[(1 << total_Ns_5) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> state : possible_states_5.entrySet()) {
            if (((state.getKey() & final_mask_bit) != 0)) {
                total_res_5 = total_res_5.add(state.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_res_5.v);
    }
}
